description: 11-bus and 240-bus radial distribution feeder datasets for power flow calculation is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Pedro Vasconcelos. This dataset includes the system data and equivalent Distributed Energy Resource (DER) allocations for two test cases: an 11-bus system and a 240-bus radial test feeder. The 11-bus system data is based on the CIGRE Technical Report "Benchmark system for network integration of renewable and distributed energy resources," 575, 2014. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
